The '''ZR-57 orbital strike bomb''' was a weapon designed to destroy major urban centers and was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], most notably in the [[Separatist War]]. One of these bombs was stolen by the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] on the island of [[Avilatan]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], from a crashed transport, around [[3643 BBY]]. Its firepower would have been enough to level the island, and [[Havoc Squad]] was dispatched to recover the bomb. When it was ascertained that the bomb was taken inside the separatists' mountain fortress, Havoc, excluding the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|newly transferred sergeant]], departed to retrieve it but suddenly dropped off the grid. Thus, Lieutenant [[Aric Jorgan]] sent the sergeant into the volcano and transmitted the deactivation code, rendering the bomb a radioactive paperweight. When the sergeant discovered that the rest of Havoc was ready to defect to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], they already had the ZR-57 loaded onto their shuttle, unaware that the sergeant disarmed it.

At the start of the [[Galactic War]], Lord [[Torius]] reactivated the ZR-57, brought it to [[Voss]], and placed it underneath the mountain city of [[Voss-Ka]]. Torius intended to use the bomb to hold the [[Voss (species)|Voss people]] hostage and force them to submit, but his plan was stopped by the new Havoc Squad. An entourage of Voss then appeared, explaining that a Mystic had a vision that Havoc would be the one to stop Torius and asked to study the bomb. Havoc politely refused, as the bomb was Republic property, so the Voss departed.
